name: FlexyPress Post View
author: flexypress

sections.description:
The FlexyPress Post View Plugin is a powerful and flexible tool for tracking and displaying the number of views on your WordPress posts or pages. With this plugin, you can effortlessly showcase your content’s popularity using the simple shortcode [flexypress_pv_show_post_view].
Whether you’re running a blog, a portfolio, or a business site, the FlexyPress Post View Plugin provides insightful analytics to help you understand your audience better and highlight your most popular content.

Features

  • Post View Tracking: Monitor how many times your posts or pages are viewed.
  • Unique View Counting: Option to count only unique views, excluding repeat visits from the same user.
  • Customizable Time Interval: Define a time interval to ignore repeated views, ensuring accurate data collection.
  • Selective Post Types: Enable view tracking for specific post types, tailoring the plugin to suit your needs.
  • Easy Display: Use a straightforward shortcode to show post view counts anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin require any plugin to be installed?

No.

Can I use this plugin with any themes?

Yes, you can. This plugin works with any themes without any limitation.
